Task: Streaming Speech-to-Text

Write Python code that streams audio chunks from an async source using one concrete third-party managed service or hosted API.

output_text:
import os
import asyncio
import base64
import json
from typing import AsyncIterable, AsyncIterator, Optional

import websockets


class DeepgramStreamingSTT:
    def __init__(
        self,
        api_key: Optional[str] = None,
        *,
        language: str = "en-US",
        model: str = "nova-2",
        encoding: str = "linear16",
        sample_rate: int = 16000,
        channels: int = 1,
        interim_results: bool = True,
        punctuate: bool = True,
        endpointing: int = 300,
    ) -> None:
        self.api_key = api_key or os.environ["DEEPGRAM_API_KEY"]
        self.language = language
        self.model = model
        self.encoding = encoding
        self.sample_rate = sample_rate
        self.channels = channels
        self.interim_results = interim_results
        self.punctuate = punctuate
        self.endpointing = endpointing

    async def transcribe(
        self,
        audio_chunks: AsyncIterable[bytes],
    ) -> AsyncIterator[dict]:
        params = {
            "model": self.model,
            "language": self.language,
            "encoding": self.encoding,
            "sample_rate": str(self.sample_rate),
            "channels": str(self.channels),
            "interim_results": str(self.interim_results).lower(),
            "punctuate": str(self.punctuate).lower(),
            "endpointing": str(self.endpointing),
        }

        query = "&".join(f"{k}={v}" for k, v in params.items())
        uri = f"wss://api.deepgram.com/v1/listen?{query}"

        async with websockets.connect(
            uri,
            additional_headers={"Authorization": f"Token {self.api_key}"},
            max_size=None,
            ping_interval=20,
            ping_timeout=20,
        ) as ws:
            sender = asyncio.create_task(self._send_audio(ws, audio_chunks))
            receiver = asyncio.create_task(self._receive_results(ws))

            try:
                async for result in self._iterate_results(receiver):
                    yield result
            finally:
                if not sender.done():
                    sender.cancel()
                if not receiver.done():
                    receiver.cancel()
                await asyncio.gather(sender, receiver, return_exceptions=True)

    async def _send_audio(self, ws, audio_chunks: AsyncIterable[bytes]) -> None:
        async for chunk in audio_chunks:
            if chunk:
                await ws.send(chunk)
        await ws.send(json.dumps({"type": "Finalize"}))

    async def _receive_results(self, ws) -> AsyncIterator[dict]:
        while True:
            message = await ws.recv()
            if isinstance(message, bytes):
                message = message.decode("utf-8")
            payload = json.loads(message)

            msg_type = payload.get("type")

            if msg_type == "Results":
                channel = payload.get("channel", {})
                alternatives = channel.get("alternatives", [])
                transcript = alternatives[0].get("transcript", "") if alternatives else ""
                if transcript:
                    yield {
                        "provider": "deepgram",
                        "model": self.model,
                        "transcript": transcript,
                        "is_final": payload.get("is_final", False),
                        "speech_final": payload.get("speech_final", False),
                        "start": payload.get("start"),
                        "duration": payload.get("duration"),
                        "raw": payload,
                    }
            elif msg_type == "UtteranceEnd":
                yield {
                    "provider": "deepgram",
                    "model": self.model,
                    "event": "utterance_end",
                    "last_word_end": payload.get("last_word_end"),
                    "raw": payload,
                }
            elif msg_type == "Metadata":
                yield {
                    "provider": "deepgram",
                    "model": self.model,
                    "event": "metadata",
                    "raw": payload,
                }
            elif msg_type == "CloseStream":
                break

    async def _iterate_results(self, receiver_task: asyncio.Task) -> AsyncIterator[dict]:
        queue: asyncio.Queue = asyncio.Queue()

        async def pump() -> None:
            async for item in await receiver_task:
                await queue.put(item)
            await queue.put(None)

        pump_task = asyncio.create_task(pump())
        try:
            while True:
                item = await queue.get()
                if item is None:
                    break
                yield item
        finally:
            if not pump_task.done():
                pump_task.cancel()
            await asyncio.gather(pump_task, return_exceptions=True)


async def stream_transcriptions(audio_chunks: AsyncIterable[bytes]) -> AsyncIterator[dict]:
    stt = DeepgramStreamingSTT(model="nova-2")
    async for result in stt.transcribe(audio_chunks):
        yield result
